title: Meet Cameron the iPad Holder
content: Meet "Cameron" the iPad holder with a little sculpted face on the side. (I made the face out of Model Magic). The pupil of his eye is really a hole above the iPad's camera to remind me to "look the viewers in the eye" and also that the CAMERA-is-ON.I'll be using him for mygouache painting live webstream today at 4:00 NY time on ConcertWindow.You canfollow this link to my broadcast pageand be there when I go live. The show will last for one hour. It's totally interactive, with Jeanette reading your questions while I paint.There are also special tip rewards show here, such as signed, hand-remarqued first day covers of the Australian dinosaur stamps, and a customized doorknob hanger to put on your studio door.Gurney gouache painting live webstream today at 4:00 NY time on ConcertWindow.
